newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Police say bomb threat at Japan's Jakarta embassy.
newsitem.headline: Police say bomb threat at Japan's Jakarta embassy.

text.p: Indonesian police said the Japanese embassy in Jakarta had received a bomb threat from an anonymous telephone caller on Wednesday morning, the second in eight days.
"Yes, the embassy has received a bomb threat," an official at a police post near the embassy told Reuters.

A policeman outside the embassy, one of a dozen preventing visitors from entering the compound, said an unknown person had phoned at 9:25 a.m. (0225 GMT) to say there was a bomb in the embassy, and then hung up.
The embassy was evacuated on Wednesday last week following a hoax bomb threat by telephone.
